title: China Trip 2027 – Places to See
notes: Ratings 1–5 are fit to the trip criteria. Prices in RMB; 'approximate' marks estimates.

places.name: Ping An Finance Centre – Free Sky 116F
places.name_zh: 平安金融中心云际观光
places.description: 360° deck at ~548 m on the 116th floor; on clear days you see toward Hong Kong
places.practical: Paid ticket (the name “Free Sky” is branding). One listing gives 10:00–19:15. Go before sunset for day + night views

places.name: Civic Center & central axis
places.description: Golden wave-roofed civic building on the green axis up to Lianhuashan; drone shows are sometimes staged on the plaza
places.practical: Next to your hotel; best at dusk

places.name: Shenzhen Bay & “Spring Bamboo” tower
places.name_zh: 深圳湾 / 华润大厦春笋
places.description: Sleek super-HQ district by the water; pair with MixC Shenzhen Bay and the bay park
places.practical: Metro Houhai

places.name: Shenzhen Library & Concert Hall
places.description: Striking public buildings on the Civic Center axis; nice quiet interior
places.practical: Next to your hotel; quick stop

places.name: Shenzhen Natural History Museum
places.description: Opened 28 Jul 2026; South China's largest, 8 halls from cosmos to dinosaurs to local ecology; striking river-delta architecture with a roof park
places.practical: 80 RMB. Book via WeChat account “深圳自然博物馆” with passport name. Pingshan (far east): Metro Line 16 to Shaba, Exit D. Allow a half day+; expect families

places.name: OCT Loft Creative Culture Park
places.description: Old factories turned galleries, design shops, bookshops, cafés; very adult and photogenic
places.practical: Metro Qiaocheng North. Combine with coconut-chicken lunch on the 4F terrace there (see Restaurants)

places.name: Shenzhen Museum
places.description: Good story of the city's rise from fishing villages to tech hub
places.practical: At the Civic Center, next to your hotel; its popular animal specimens moved to the new Natural History Museum

places.name: Nantou Ancient City
places.description: Shenzhen's historic walled town: old gate, temples and Lingnan houses, now with small free museums, cafés and craft shops. Google 4.3 (~170 reviews)
places.practical: Free. 5 min walk from its metro station; plan ~2 h. Crowded and commercial at weekends: go on a weekday morning

places.name: Hehu Hakka Walled House
places.description: One of Shenzhen's largest Hakka walled villages, palace-like, housing the Longgang Hakka Culture Museum (most displays in English). Google 4.9 (7 reviews); museum 4.2 (29)
places.practical: Free or ~10 RMB (reviews differ). Plan 2–3 h. Far east in Longgang, roughly 1 h+ from the hotel (approximate); quiet on weekdays

places.name: Dawan Ancestral House
places.description: Large, quiet Qing-era Hakka castle-style compound: 400+ rooms, corner watchtowers. Google 4.6 (9 reviews)
places.practical: Far east in Pingshan; combine with the Natural History Museum. Taxi recommended (approximate)

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Shenzhen Bay Park + mangrove boardwalks
places.name_zh: 深圳湾公园 / 红树林
places.description: 15 km seaside greenway (walk or rent a bike); the mangrove reserve is a major stop for migratory birds
places.practical: Short metro/taxi ride; free

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Lianhuashan Park
places.description: ~150 ha hilltop park with skyline views over the CBD
places.practical: Walk up the central axis from your hotel; free

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Hongqiao (Red Bridge) Park
places.description: 4 km red elevated walkway (5 m wide, ~8 m high) curving over lakes and forest; award-winning design, very photogenic
places.practical: Guangming District: Metro Line 6 to Fenghuang Town (凤凰城站), Exit B; roughly 1 h (approximate). Park 6:00–22:00; free

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Fairy Lake Botanical Garden
places.description: Proper trails, lakes and temples; quieter than Lianhuashan
places.practical: East Luohu, taxi; half a day

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Wutong Mountain
places.description: Highest peak in Shenzhen (944 m); 4–5 h return hike, big views
places.practical: East Luohu; free. For fit walkers only

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Dapeng Fortress + Xichong beach
places.description: 1394 Ming garrison town with old lanes and temples; Xichong has the clearest water near Shenzhen and a coastal trail
places.practical: Car 60–90 min (Xichong 75–100 min). By bus 2.5–3 h — too long, take Didi

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Dameisha & Yantian seaside boardwalk
places.name_zh: 大梅沙 / 盐田海滨栈道
places.description: Free beach and a long coastal promenade; a walk, not swimming weather in January
places.practical: Taxi ~1 h (approximate)

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Tanglang Mountain
places.description: Easier forest trail with city views from the ridge
places.practical: Nanshan, metro; free

places.name: Huaqiangbei
places.description: One of the world's largest electronics markets: floors of components, gadgets, phone gear; SEG Plaza and Huaqiang Electronics World
places.practical: Metro Huaqiangbei. Bring a specific list; bargain in stalls; parts sell open fakes

places.name: MixC Shenzhen Bay
places.description: Luxury retail mixed with art installations and a MixC Arts space, beside the Spring Bamboo tower
places.practical: Metro Houhai, Exit G. Try the egg tarts at Yu Lian Tea House

places.name: Dafen Oil Painting Village
places.description: Lanes of studios painting to order; one of the best places in the world to buy a painting
places.practical: Line 3 to Dafen, Exit A1; 09:30–17:30, closed Mondays; bargain

places.name: MixC World
places.description: Open-air design-led lifestyle mall, trendy shops and food
places.practical: Metro High-Tech Park area

places.name: COCO Park
places.description: Big Futian mall with international brands and lots of restaurants (incl. a Seasons coconut-chicken branch, L3); lively bar street in the evening. Convenient rather than epic
places.practical: 268 Fuhua 3rd Rd, close to your hotel; Metro Convention & Exhibition Center. Handy for an easy dinner

places.name: Dongmen Pedestrian Street
places.description: Oldest shopping street: cheap streetwear, malls, snack alleys, busy local buzz
places.practical: Metro Laojie. Crowded and less polished; bargain

places.name: Sea World, Shekou
places.description: Waterfront plaza with international restaurants and bars; nice evening
places.practical: Metro Sea World

places.name: Upperhills
places.description: Village-style open-air mall on a raised plaza by Lianhuashan: low-rise lanes of cafés, design shops and restaurants
places.practical: ~10 min from the hotel (approximate); free

places.name: OCT Harbour
places.description: Open-air waterfront shopping and dining around a lake and the Bay Area Eye Ferris wheel in Bao'an; nicest at sunset
places.practical: ~45 min by metro (approximate); free

places.name: One Avenue
places.description: Upscale Futian mall with international and Chinese designer brands and lots of food
places.practical: Close to the hotel; free

places.name: Luohu Commercial City
places.description: Tailors, bags, watches; mostly knock-offs and hard-sell
places.practical: Only if you want tailoring

places.name: The Bay by Chef Fei
places.description: Michelin 2★ refined Cantonese by the chef of Guangzhou's Jiang
places.watch_out: Book well ahead; set menus

places.name: Yun Jing
places.description: Michelin 2★ Cantonese
places.watch_out: Book well ahead

places.name: Chao Shang Chao
places.description: Michelin 1★ Chaozhou cuisine
places.watch_out: Chaozhou braised platters can include offal: order à la carte

places.name: Xin Rong Ji
places.description: Michelin 1★ Taizhou seafood
places.watch_out: Book ahead; a Hong Kong branch review mentions pushy upselling

places.name: Runyuan Four Seasons Coconut Chicken
places.description: Free-range chicken cooked in fresh coconut water; claypot rice
places.watch_out: OCT Loft branch: 4F OCT East Market, open-air terrace

places.name: Chaoshan beef hot pot – Chaofa or Baheli Haiji
places.name_zh: 潮发潮汕牛肉店 / 八合里海记
places.description: Same-day fresh beef sliced to order in clear broth; beef balls
places.watch_out: Menus also list tongue, heart, tendon and tripe: order the plain sliced cuts

places.name: Fan Lou
places.description: Handmade dim sum; 4.8 on Dianping from ~9,000 reviews
places.watch_out: On weekends take a queue number 1–2 h ahead

places.name: Jin Yue Xuan
places.description: Polished dim sum (8:00–14:00), seafood dinners
places.watch_out: 6013 Shennan Ave, near your hotel

places.name: Dian Dou De
places.description: Shrimp dumplings, siu mai, char siu bao, rice rolls
places.watch_out: Skip chicken feet and tripe; several branches

places.name: Chuxianglou
places.description: Old-name teahouse, 100% handmade dim sum
places.watch_out: Metro Laojie Exit C; pair with Dongmen

links.source: https://global.hk01.com/旅游/60268880/深圳早茶11间-点心-5-免茶位-近罗湖福田口岸-1间本地人力推

places.name: Fenghuang Lou
places.description: Classic Shenzhen yum cha since 1989
places.watch_out: Good before Huaqiangbei shopping

places.name: Dimlar
places.description: Steamed-to-order dim sum, char siu pastry, shrimp wonton noodles
places.watch_out: Pair with Shenzhen Bay Park / MixC

links.source: https://global.hk01.com/旅游/60332594/深圳湾饮茶8大推介-人均-55-点心即叫即蒸-必试叉烧酥-虾饺王

places.name: Yu Lian Tea House egg tarts
places.description: Locals call them the city's best egg tarts
places.watch_out: Inside MixC World / MixC Shenzhen Bay

places.name: Xin Dou Ji
places.description: Hong Kong-style yum cha
places.watch_out: Close to your hotel

places.name: Chun Man Yuan
places.description: Reliable Cantonese dim sum chain
places.watch_out: Several branches

links.source: https://global.hk01.com/旅游/60268880/深圳早茶11间-点心-5-免茶位-近罗湖福田口岸-1间本地人力推

places.name: Lovers' Road + Fisher Girl statue
places.description: 28+ km palm-lined seaside promenade past the city's icons, incl. the Love Post Office and lighthouse; the statue is lit up at night
places.practical: The core of the day; walk or rent a bike; free

places.name: Zhuhai Grand Theatre
places.description: Shell-shaped opera house on Yeli Island, right on the water
places.practical: Next to Lovers' Road; best photographed at dusk

places.name: Jingshan Park cable car
places.description: Cable car up for panoramic coastline views
places.practical: Near the centre; short stop

places.name: Jinwan Civic Art Center
places.description: Zaha Hadid building on an artificial lake
places.practical: Far southwest in Jinwan district; only for architecture fans

places.name: Canton Tower
places.description: 600 m twisted tower; the open-air top deck looks over the whole river city
places.practical: Indoor decks ~135 RMB; open-air deck a separate ~228 RMB ticket. Open to 22:30, last entry 22:00; lights on ~19:00. Metro Canton Tower. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Pearl River night cruise
places.description: ~70 min past the lit-up skyline, Canton Tower and old bund
places.practical: From Tianzi Pier (天字码头), ~10 min walk from the Canton Hotel. 18:00–22:30; adult 98 RMB (1F) to 198 RMB (open deck). Near: Old town

places.name: Huacheng Square & Zhujiang New Town
places.name_zh: 花城广场 / 珠江新城
places.description: Green central axis between skyscrapers, with the Canton Tower across the river; spectacular lit up
places.practical: Free. Metro Huacheng Avenue / Zhujiang New Town. Walking distance from your Tianhe hotel. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Guangzhou Opera House
places.description: Zaha Hadid's "pebbles" on the river bank
places.practical: Exterior free; combine with Huacheng Square. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Sacred Heart Cathedral
places.description: 19th-century all-granite Gothic cathedral in the old town
places.practical: Free; open to visitors at set hours only (check the board at the gate). ~15 min walk from the Canton Hotel. Near: Old town

places.name: Haixinsha Island
places.description: River island at the foot of Huacheng Square: closest straight-on view of the tower
places.practical: Free; 15 min add-on to Huacheng Square. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Chen Clan Academy
places.description: 1890s clan hall covered in carved wood, brick, stone and ceramic roof figures; also the Folk Arts Museum
places.practical: ~10 RMB, bring passport. 09:00–17:30, ticket office to 17:00. Metro Chen Clan Academy (Line 1/8), Exit D. Near: Old town

places.name: Shamian Island
places.description: Quiet former foreign concession: banyan avenues, colonial villas, churches, riverside cafés
places.practical: Free. Metro Huangsha (Line 1/6). Good for a slow morning or golden hour. Near: Old town

places.name: Guangdong Museum
places.description: Lacquer-box building on Huacheng Square; strong Chaozhou woodcarving, ceramics and Cantonese crafts halls
places.practical: Free but real-name booking required: WeChat mini program 广东省博物馆预约, slots open 22:00, up to 7 days ahead. Tue–Sun 09:00–17:00, closed Mon. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Nanyue King Mausoleum
places.name_zh: 南越王博物院·王墓展区
places.description: 2,100-year-old royal tomb you walk into; jade burial suit and a famous ceramic pillow collection
places.practical: ~10 RMB, book via WeChat 南越王博物院. Tue–Sun 09:00–17:30, closed Mon. Metro Yuexiu Park, Exit E. Near: Old town

places.name: Yongqing Fang
places.description: Restored Xiguan lanes and arcade houses, Cantonese opera museum next door, Bruce Lee's ancestral home
places.practical: Free to wander. Metro Huangsha or Changshou Lu. Combine with Shamian. Near: Old town

places.name: Temple of the Six Banyan Trees
places.description: 1,400-year-old temple with a 57 m painted Flower Pagoda
places.practical: Small fee or free (approximate). Metro Gongyuanqian / Ximenkou. 15 min from the Canton Hotel. Near: Old town

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Baiyun Mountain
places.description: Forested hills over the city; Moxing Ridge (摩星岭) summit view, sunset from the top
places.practical: Entry ~5 RMB (+5 RMB summit). Cable car ~25 up / 20 down. A new escalator and sightseeing cars also go up (2026). Metro Line 3, Meihuayuan. Half a day

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Yuexiu Park
places.description: Big downtown park with the Five Rams statue, Ming-era Zhenhai Tower (Guangzhou Museum, 10 RMB) and lakes
places.practical: Free, 06:00–21:00. Metro Yuexiu Park, Exit B1. Pair with the Nanyue King Mausoleum. Near: Old town

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Haizhu Wetland Park
places.description: Huge city-centre wetland of orchards, canals and boardwalks; birds in winter
places.practical: ~20 RMB, book via WeChat 海珠湿地. Free Haizhu Lake next to it (Metro Datang, Exit B). Near: Tianhe

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Lychee Bay canal
places.description: Restored old-Xiguan canal lined with arcades, bridges and snack shops
places.practical: Free. Walk from Yongqing Fang. Near: Old town

places.category: Parks & nature (≤ 2 h from the hotel)
places.name: Huolushan Forest Park
places.description: Easy wooded hill walk in Tianhe, quieter than Baiyun
places.practical: Free (approximate). Taxi ~20 min from the Tianhe hotel. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Beijing Road
places.description: The city's oldest shopping street, with glass panels showing 1,000 years of road layers underfoot
places.practical: Your first hotel is on it. Liveliest after 18:00. Near: Old town

places.name: Fangcun Tea Market
places.description: One of Asia's largest tea markets: streets of tea shops offering tastings of pu'er, oolong and more
places.practical: Free; morning to late afternoon (approximate). Metro Kengkou / Fangcun area (approximate). Near: Old town

places.name: Hualin Jade Street
places.description: Billed as China's largest jade market; fascinating even just to look
places.practical: Quality and prices vary wildly; buy only small things unless you know jade. Near Shangxiajiu. Near: Old town

places.name: Shangxiajiu Pedestrian Street
places.description: Arcade shophouses with Cantonese snacks, herbal shops and local clothing; calmer than Beijing Road
places.practical: Combine with Hualin Jade Street and Yongqing Fang. Near: Old town

places.name: Taikoo Hui
places.description: The upscale Tianhe mall: luxury brands and a strong food floor
places.practical: ~10:00–22:00. Linked to Metro Shipaiqiao, next to your second hotel. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Yide Road dried-goods market
places.description: Street of dried seafood, mushrooms, sweets and Cantonese pantry goods
places.practical: Busiest 08:00–early afternoon. ~10 min walk from the Canton Hotel. Near: Old town

places.name: Parc Central
places.description: Tianhe mall built around a sunken garden park, with open-air terraces, trendy brands and restaurants
places.practical: Free. Next to Tianhe Sports Center. Near: Tianhe

places.name: K11 Art Mall
places.description: Art mall in Zhujiang New Town mixing shopping with exhibitions, plus a basement food market
places.practical: Free. Short walk from Huacheng Square. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Dongshankou
places.description: Leafy 1920s red-brick villa district turned trendy: independent boutiques, concept stores, cafés, galleries
places.practical: Free to wander. Near: Old town

places.name: Grandview Mall & Teemall
places.description: Big mid-range malls with Chinese brands and food courts; convenient rather than epic
places.practical: Walk from Tianhe hotel. Near: Tianhe

places.name: Jiang by Chef Fei
places.description: Michelin 2★: roast goose, Wenchang chicken with flaxseed, dim sum at lunch
places.watch_out: Near your Tianhe hotel; book ahead. Some reviews mention uneven service

places.name: Imperial Treasure Fine Chinese Cuisine
places.description: Michelin 2★ Cantonese; dim sum at lunch
places.watch_out: A reviewer calls it the best value of the three 2★; no English menu

places.name: BingSheng Mansion
places.description: Michelin 1★: roast goose, crispy char siu, pineapple bun, claypot chicken
places.watch_out: Grand dining room; Google 4.2. Order goose and char siu early, they sell out

places.name: Lei Garden
places.description: Michelin 1★ classic Cantonese: crispy roast pork, double-boiled soups, claypot rice
places.watch_out: Near Dongshankou; skip the roast pigeon

places.name: Wisca
places.description: Michelin 1★: sizzling claypot (啶啶煲) chicken, beef, vegetables
places.watch_out: Many claypots use offal (goose intestine, liver): order the chicken, beef and vegetable ones

places.name: Yu Yue Heen
places.description: Michelin 1★ Cantonese with a sky-high view over Zhujiang New Town
places.watch_out: Reviews split: great view and service, food mixed

places.name: Hongtu Hall, White Swan Hotel
places.description: Michelin 1★ refined dim sum with Pearl River views
places.watch_out: 08:00–14:30; book, or queue from ~07:30

places.name: Guangzhou Restaurant
places.description: The city's most famous Cantonese restaurant since 1935
places.watch_out: Book or arrive early at weekends

places.name: Tao Tao Ju
places.description: Century-old teahouse: har gow, char siu bao, wife cakes (老婆饼)
places.watch_out: Weekend queues from before 09:00. Skip chicken feet and tripe

places.name: Panxi Restaurant
places.description: Elaborate dim sum in a lakeside garden
places.watch_out: Weekday 08:00–10:00 is calm; near Chen Clan Academy

places.name: Fa Sing Garden
places.description: Michelin Bib Gourmand Cantonese
places.watch_out: Close to your Tianhe hotel; check the menu for offal

places.name: Dian Dou De
places.description: All-day dim sum; red rice rolls with crispy shrimp
places.watch_out: English picture menu; Huacheng Ave branch near your Tianhe hotel

places.name: E Qian Ya Hou
places.description: Michelin Bib Gourmand: white-cut goose and duck
places.watch_out: Skip giblet dishes

places.name: Yin Ji Rice Rolls
places.description: Silky rice rolls with shrimp, beef or egg; congee
places.watch_out: Good breakfast near Shangxiajiu

places.name: Nanxin Milk Desserts
places.description: Double-skin milk, ginger milk curd, egg custard
places.watch_out: Dessert stop on a Liwan walk

places.name: Kaiping Diaolou
places.description: UNESCO-listed fortified watchtower villages among rice fields
places.practical: ~2–2.5 h each way (approximate): over your 2-hour rule, only by Didi or a tour

places.name: Foshan Ancestral Temple
places.description: Ornate temple with the Ip Man Hall (Wing Chun, wooden-dummy room); lion dance daily at 10:00, 14:15 and 15:30; Cantonese opera Sat/Sun 14:00–15:30
places.practical: 20 RMB, real-name booking on WeChat the day before. 08:30–17:45. Metro Zumiao (Guangfo Line). Shows cancelled in rain. The Wong Fei-hung hall here is closed for building work

places.name: Wong Fei-hung Lion Dance & Martial Arts Hall
places.description: Museum in Wong Fei-hung's birthplace village, Luzhou
places.practical: Free, 09:00–17:00. Its lion dance shows moved to Tianhu Park on Xiqiao Mountain (11:00, 14:00, 15:30). Combine with Xiqiao Mountain

places.name: Bruce Lee Paradise + ancestral home
places.description: Giant statue and memorial hall, plus the small house his grandfather built (Bruce Lee never lived there). Google 4.5 (22 reviews)
places.practical: Paradise free since Sep 2026, 09:00–17:30; memorial hall may be under renovation; the park also has rides. Far south in Shunde: by car or a long bus ride. Easier alternative: his father's house in Guangzhou's Yongqing Fang

places.name: Lingnan Tiandi
places.description: Restored Lingnan lanes next to the Ancestral Temple: craft shops, cafés, restaurants, an old opera house. Google 4.5 (340 reviews)
places.practical: Free. Good for dinner after the temple; busy at weekends

places.name: Nanfeng Ancient Kiln
places.description: Dragon kilns from 1506, still firing pottery; old lanes of ceramic studios and shops. Google 4.5 (54 reviews)
places.practical: ~25 RMB (per a review). Metro Shiwan, 10 min walk; English booklet at the visitor centre. Plan 1–2 h

places.name: Qinghui Garden
places.description: One of Guangdong's four famous classical gardens: ponds, pavilions, coloured-glass windows. Google 4.3 (211 reviews)
places.practical: ~15 RMB (per a review), pay via WeChat. ~1 h visit. Next to Huagai Road food street

places.name: Fengjian Water Village
places.description: Canal village of red-sandstone banks, old bridges and snack shops; boat rides. Google 3.9 (110 reviews)
places.practical: Free to wander. Reviewers say don't expect Venice; nice on a dry day

places.name: Xiqiao Mountain
places.description: Forested volcanic hills with a giant seated bronze Guanyin statue and peaceful temples. Google 4.6 (37 reviews)
places.practical: Take the round-trip tram up. Cold in winter: bring a jacket. ~1.5 h from Tianhe (approximate). Ticket price not checked

places.name: Huagai Road food street
places.description: Double-skin milk, ginger milk curd, Shunde snacks; good for an early dinner
places.practical: Next to Qinghui Garden. Check fish and meat dishes for offal before ordering
